categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Mempool' and modifies mempool reorg eviction logic in `src/validation.cpp` to prevent false eviction of BIP68 transactions.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where `removeForReorg` evaluates sequence locks against stale cached lockpoints and erroneously evicts valid BIP68 transactions and their descendants upon a reorg to a lower tip or median time past (#35007).

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Although touching `src/validation.cpp`, the change exclusively affects mempool lockpoint recalculation and eviction during reorgs, which the validation category definition explicitly delegates to `mempool`.
categories.rationale: Mempool reorg maintenance is part of mempool policy and state management rather than block validation or chainstate consensus rules.
